title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 02, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B4.2 (Peaked November 02, 2026 at 16:44 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 395 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

The Sun rotates! Its equator makes a rotation in roughly 25 days. 🌞

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
